translations./components/0/description: A balanced rubber track-pad and road-wheel package for ordinary hard ground.
translations./components/1/description: Soft high-grip pads shorten braking distance but consume more energy while scrub steering.
translations./components/2/description: Firm low-resistance pads save cruise energy but need more distance to stop on wet ground.
translations./components/3/description: Wide grousers retain traction on loose ground but consume more energy while turning on hard surfaces.
